subject: DHCP pool exhaustion on RTR-0071-01 causing guest Wi-Fi connectivity issues
description: Multiple guests at the Dadar location are unable to connect to the guest Wi-Fi network. Upon investigation, the NetLink NL-3000 router appears to have exhausted its DHCP address pool, preventing new device connections. The issue began this afternoon around 4:45 PM and has persisted. Previous troubleshooting involved a basic restart of the router, but the problem recurred within an hour.

ticket_history.note: Ticket received and acknowledged. Confirmed DHCP pool exhaustion on RTR-0071-01 with 254/254 addresses allocated. Advised store manager to check for rogue DHCP clients or IP address leaks before escalation.
